input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes a field-of-use non-compete on the Company. It fails the fallback on three material terms: the scope is elastic ("products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and "companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled") rather than limited to a named competing product; there is no 12-month outside limit (the one-year term auto-renews, so "during the term of this Agreement" is open-ended); and there is no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions (Section 6.2 carves out only closeout merchandise). We propose the fallback narrowing rather than deletion because HDI's exclusive hosting bargain plausibly needs some protection: scope is limited to Deerskin Products, and a short added sentence caps the restriction at 12 months and carves out internal development and acquired businesses.

ops.oldText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand
ops.newText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand

ops.text: The restriction in Section 6.1 shall apply during the term of this Agreement and in any event for no longer than 12 months, and shall not restrict the Company from internally developing web sites or from continuing to operate any business or web site acquired by the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the products we sell or the businesses we operate, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products and removed the open-ended "substantially similar products/companies" language. The added sentence caps the restriction at 12 months and carves out our internal development and acquired businesses, while preserving HDI's exclusivity for the term.
proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 non-compete to Deerskin Products and add a 12-month cap plus internal-development and acquisition carve-outs.

mappings.element: Restriction limited to a named competing product.
